title: bug: CLI strtoul missing range check and piv_slot uninitialized
description: Two related CLI bugs in wp11_cli.c: (1) strtoul() is called for slot IDs in cmd_attest, cmd_list_keys, cmd_list_mechanisms without checking errno==ERANGE or that the result is within [0, WOLFP11_CFG_MAX_SLOTS). Input 'wp11 list-mechanisms 99999999999' silently wraps or passes an invalid slot to the PKCS#11 layer. (2) piv_slot in cmd_attest is declared but not initialized; if the slot-string if/else chain is ever refactored and the else-return removed, the uninitialized value reaches wp11_piv_attest_slot. Fix: (1) add bounds check after strtoul; (2) initialize piv_slot=0 at declaration.
